ruleset.name: nitpicker-test-honesty
ruleset.description: Nitpicker's PMD rules for test sources.

rule.name: TestSleep
rule.message: Do not sleep in a test. Wait for the condition with a deadline (poll until it holds), or control time with an injected Clock. If it is right here, add an exception for pmd/TestSleep in nitpicker.config.json.
rule.description: A sleep makes a test slow and flaky.

rule.name: DisabledTest
rule.message: Fix or delete this test instead of disabling it. If it is right here, add an exception for pmd/DisabledTest in nitpicker.config.json.

rule.name: TestAssumption
rule.message: A failed assumption skips the test silently. Assert the precondition, or split the test by environment. If it is right here, add an exception for pmd/TestAssumption in nitpicker.config.json.
rule.description: Assumptions turn a failure into a skip.

rule.name: AssertionInControlFlow
rule.message: Assert unconditionally. Replace the loop or if with assertAll, a parameterized test (@ParameterizedTest) or separate tests. If it is right here, add an exception for pmd/AssertionInControlFlow in nitpicker.config.json.
rule.description: An assertion that may not run proves nothing.

property.name: xpath

rule.name: TryCatchInTest
rule.message: Use assertThrows(Type.class, () -> call()) to expect an exception, and let unexpected ones fail the test. If it is right here, add an exception for pmd/TryCatchInTest in nitpicker.config.json.
rule.description: try/catch in a test hides failures or asserts nothing.

rule.name: AssertTrueOnEquality
rule.message: Use assertEquals(expected, actual) or assertThat(actual).isEqualTo(expected), so a failure shows both values. Use assertSame for identity. If it is right here, add an exception for pmd/AssertTrueOnEquality in nitpicker.config.json.

property.name: xpath

rule.name: TautologicalAssertion
rule.message: This assertion cannot fail. Assert the value the code under test produces. If it is right here, add an exception for pmd/TautologicalAssertion in nitpicker.config.json.
rule.description: A constant assertion passes whatever the code does.

property.name: xpath

rule.name: MockedValueType
rule.message: Do not mock a value type (String, number, date, collection, Optional or record). Construct a real instance. If it is right here, add an exception for pmd/MockedValueType in nitpicker.config.json.
rule.description: A mocked value only tests the mock.

rule.name: VerifyOnlyTest
rule.message: Assert on the result or state the code produces. verify() alone only shows that a call was made. If it is right here, add an exception for pmd/VerifyOnlyTest in nitpicker.config.json.
rule.description: A test that only verifies calls pins the implementation, not the behavior.

property.name: xpath

rule.name: TestOrderDependence
rule.message: Tests must not depend on order: give each test its own state and remove @TestMethodOrder, @FixMethodOrder and @Order. If it is right here, add an exception for pmd/TestOrderDependence in nitpicker.config.json.
rule.description: Order-dependent tests fail when run alone or in parallel.
